title: DogTag credential envelope v1
description: Shared W3C VC 2.0 envelope and legal-meta fields every DogTag credential carries, mirroring the unconditional checks in packages/dogtag-standard-ts/src/schema.ts (validateSchema). Every per-record-type schema in this registry composes this one via allOf. Deliberately open-world (no additionalProperties/unevaluatedProperties restriction): schema.ts itself never rejects an unknown field, and the plan's own versioning rule treats adding a keyPath within a version as always allowed, so a record-type schema layering extra fields on top of this envelope must not be rejected by it.

microchip.description: The shared microchip shape, referenced by $ref from every record-type schema that can carry one (mirrors schema.ts's single needsChip-gated microchip block, reused verbatim across record types).

code.description: ISO 11784/11785 15-digit microchip code, always a string (never a bare number - schema.ts rejects a numeric code outright).

implantDate.description: Presence-only at this layer; cross-field date comparisons against implantDate are declared in each consuming record schema's x-validationRules where they apply.

@context.description: @context[0] must be the W3C VC 2.0 base context exactly; the DogTag context URI must appear somewhere in the array (schema.ts checks membership, not position). items:true after the 1-tuple prefixItems means any further entries are unrestricted.
